name: Aerostratospheric Defense GIR
description: Geospatial Information Repository for Aerostratospheric Defense Systems. Open and partner tiers use public Earth-observation and OSINT-compatible reference data only. Restricted tier is defined structurally but not populated with classified content in this public repository.

access_tiers.open: Public science and open EO products
access_tiers.restricted: Authorized government/military only — not stored in public repo

imagery_index.description: Catalog of worldwide open satellite / EO imagery sources and STAC-compatible endpoints

anomalies.description: Anomaly and early-warning events (public UOGW + future partner streams)

reference_features.description: Public reference geospatial features (ports, airports, published infrastructure). No classified sites.

policy.public_repo_contains: Open EO catalogs, public anomaly samples, public reference features only
